parameters.query:
SELECT
 COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(x ORDER BY x.expires_at DESC) FROM (SELECT cp.id, cp.name, cp.sessions_total, package_remaining(cp.id) AS remaining, cp.price_paid::float AS price_paid, cp.session_value::float AS session_value,
    cp.product_id, pr.name AS product_name, cp.purchased_at, cp.expires_at, cp.status, (cp.status = 'active' AND cp.expires_at >= now()) AS usable
    FROM client_packages cp LEFT JOIN products pr ON pr.id = cp.product_id WHERE cp.contact_id = $1::int) x), '[]'::json) AS packages,
 COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(y ORDER BY y.renews_at DESC) FROM (SELECT cm.id, cm.name, cm.price::float AS price, cm.discount_percent::float AS discount_percent, cm.included_sessions, membership_remaining(cm.id) AS remaining,
    cm.session_value::float AS session_value, cm.period_start, cm.renews_at, cm.status, (cm.status = 'active' AND cm.renews_at >= now()) AS usable
    FROM client_memberships cm WHERE cm.contact_id = $1::int) y), '[]'::json) AS memberships;
